verdict.rationale: Orama's GitHub feature list includes Pinning Rules (Merchandising), which lets a developer apply a custom ranking rule on top of relevance; the same list also shows Fields Boosting, though that only weights text fields. Neither item has documentation detail, and nothing shows ranking by popularity, recency, margin or other numeric business signals. Missing for 10: documented scoring or ranking on business-signal fields (popularity, recency, margin), custom ranking-function or score-modifier documentation, depth on how pinning rules work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can shape relevance with custom ranking rules and business signals (popularity, recency, margin) beyond textual matching
